summary: The first fixing chat of the Kiln Run Restart whole-PRD test audit worked the two highest rows. AC-CARRY-04 is now Adequate (16 of 16 parts), and AC-CURRENT-01 rose from 13 of 24 to 24 of 26 parts but stays Weak: a fresh re-grader still finds a command at a held phase that offers carry-on, and several repositories caught up at a stop, unproven. Every new test was seen to fail against a deliberate break, apart from launch guards the audit doesn't break. A new test exposed a real race: Kiln's own git status reads could hold the worktree's index lock and make a stopped phase's catch-up fail; both reads now pass --no-optional-locks (commit 1687340), so a fresh delivery audit is due. The full suite passed. The remaining 17 Weak rows are recorded in order under To fix in docs/changes/kiln-run-restart/test-audit.md.
